## Governance rules

- **Intake flow:** issue → triage → map to a P or future program → slice → PR → merge → post-merge verification → update this register (feature + slice status).
- **Completion:** Immediately after merge + post-merge verification, the slice and its features become implemented with PR, merge SHA, tests and evidence; remaining debt is recorded as Pn-Mnn. An open PR means in-progress, never implemented.
- **Delivery model (DEC-0014):** Slice = delivery boundary, Task = execution boundary, PR = slice delivery boundary. Every Slice produces exactly one delivery PR. A Slice may contain one or many Tasks (on different workers); their commits are reconciled into the Slice's single PR. Tasks of a Slice never deliver their own PR to main. Slice completion gate: (1) all tasks of the slice are done; (2) slice acceptance criteria are met; (3) exactly one delivery PR exists; (4) the PR's exact-head CI/gates passed; (5) the PR is merged to main; (6) main is re-verified; (7) evidence is recorded; (8) this milestone register is updated.
- **Slice naming:** historical: Pn.m (and P3 "Slice X") — pre-reset ids, immutable; feature: Pn-Snn — new work inside an existing P (completed Ps may receive slices); maintenance: Pn-Mnn — hardening / debt / maintenance inside an existing P; futureProgram: <FUTURE-PROGRAM>-Snn — a slice of a thematic future program.
- **Status vocabulary:** `implemented`, `in-progress`, `planned`, `proposed`, `blocked`, `deferred`, `superseded`, `retired`, `rejected`. **Relevance:** `active`, `maintenance`, `deprecated`, `archived`.
- **Invariants:** planned != authorized != in-progress != complete; an issue existing never makes a feature implemented; features are never deleted: they move to superseded / retired / rejected with a reason; historical evidence (milestones[] rows, P n.m slices, evidence docs) is immutable.
- **Pointer scope:** currentMilestone / previousCompletedMilestone are the historical P2-ladder pointers (P2.11 -> P2.27; the generic P2.17+ label is historical and authorizes nothing), and mainBaseline is the governance-reset baseline (#257). Active work is executionPointer: latest completed slice, active and verifying slices, the planned queue and blocked slices. Program-level truth lives in programs[] and futurePrograms[]; nothing is authorized beyond the slices marked in-progress.
- **Milestone authority (DEC-0020):** Milestone truth is main-owned. A milestone design found or developed in Manager memory becomes authoritative only when reconciled into main through a PR. arena-manager is not an alternate milestone authority, and its docs/ tree is a stale snapshot that is never copied over main. Post-merge sequence: delivery PR → merge to main → post-merge verification → register status and evidence update → README milestone projection (generated) → .ai regeneration → governance PR → merge governance PR → final main verification. Nothing is batched into a later roadmap cleanup. A delivery-state change (planned -> in-progress at slice start, in-progress -> implemented, a split or a new blocker) is recorded by the next governance PR; every evidenced progress event is recorded immediately in its own governance(progress): commit, because the repository is the live project monitor (DEC-0021).

- **Branches:** Persistent branches: main and arena-manager only (DEC-0019, docs/engineering-operations/workforce/decisions/DEC-0019.json; supersedes the worker-slot branches of DEC-0003 and the agent-branch model of DEC-0017). The Manager executes every task itself; each Slice is delivered by one PR from a short-lived Manager branch that is deleted after merge. Every other branch is: A) merged -> deleted; B) important unmerged work -> PR, merge, delete; C) obsolete -> deleted after comparison with main (unique content preserved under an archive/<branch> tag).
- **Runner protocol:** docs/engineering-operations/RUNNER-PROTOCOL.md (machine-readable: docs/engineering-operations/workforce-governance.json#runnerProtocol)

### P5 — Identity / Authentication / Authorization / Credentials (Security) (complete)

Identity, sessions, authorization, credential boundary, key management, account security, API keys/service identity, certification (#85, #90).

**Acceptance:** P5.1-P5.8 merged; on main 87099dc0: CI 7/7, gates 7/7, backend 2375/2375, frontend 418 pass + 1 pre-existing skip, 100 lock rows, leakage scan 0 hits, certification 51/51, mutation check 4/4.

## Evidence roles

- Start/finish evidence is evidence, not a replacement for current state.
- An agent branch can be implementation-complete without the milestone being complete.
- `P2.27` requires **RECONCILIATION PASS**, **MERGE PASS**, and post-merge verification on protected main before it can become complete.

## Manager merge protocol

1. freeze current protected-main baseline
2. implement authorized milestone
3. run focused and relevant full gates
4. classify failures
5. reconcile against latest main
6. push branch
7. open PR
8. validate PR
9. merge immediately when valid
10. rerun post-merge verification on main
11. record completion evidence
12. advance currentMilestone
13. report Manager

**Agent completion is not merge approval:** undefined.

**Failure state:** `RECONCILIATION_FAILED`

## Refinement rule

Future milestone IDs may be split or refined when implementation evidence requires it, but only the Manager may do so and only by updating `docs/n8n-lego/milestones.json`.
